_comment: Challenge open time per account, in East Africa Time (EAT, UTC+3): 12-hour format with seconds, e.g. "8:00:03 PM".
The script messages the bot at this time, and measures 'max_quiz_seconds' (pacing_<ACCOUNT>.json) from it.
Add or edit an entry named after the account (SAF, ETH, Ab62, Ab82). Accounts without their own entry use "default", which is required.
Entries whose key starts with '_' are notes and are ignored. Keep valid JSON: double quotes, no trailing commas.
